title: Clone, commit, push
setup: git init -q --bare remote.git && git --git-dir=remote.git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main

here=$PWD && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$tmp" && git init -q . && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main && printf '# Team notes\n' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'Add README' && git push -q "$here/remote.git" main && cd "$here" && rm -rf "$tmp"

checks.name: mycopy is a clone of the remote
checks.cmd: test -d mycopy/.git && git -C mycopy remote get-url origin | grep -q 'remote.git'

checks.name: the remote has your new commit
nothing is left uncommitted in mycopy

hints: A remote can be a folder: git clone remote.git mycopy
cd mycopy, create and commit notes.txt, then git push.
